newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Sun Resorts pushes up Mauritius bourse index.
newsitem.headline: Sun Resorts pushes up Mauritius bourse index.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Mauritius share index Semdex gained 2.97 points to 385.49 on Wednesday on a continued rise by hotel concern Sun Resorts.
Volume transacted rose to 23.27 million rupees on 780,920 shares from 19.07 million rupees on 1,122,634 shares on Monday.
Sun Resorts rose three to 51.50 on 226,632 shares, New Mauritius Hotels stable at 35.50 rupees on 151,500 shares and Grand Baie Hotel was unchanged to 45 rupees on 129 shares.

"There has been buying interest in Sun Resorts during the morning session as Port Louis Fund Manager BNPI (Banque Nationale de Paris Intercontinentale) has announced its interest in this hotel company," one broker told Reuters.

In the banking sector, Mauritius Commercial Bank was stable at 88 rupees on 3,645 shares, State Bank of Mauritius remained unchanged at 13 rupees on 189,960 shares and insurance-based Swan rose 20 cents on 150 shares.

Mauritius Breweries Ltd gained three rupees to 147 rupees on 18 shares, Mauritius Chemical Fertilisers Industry lost 20 cents to 10.10 rupees on 13,450 shares and United Basalt Products was unchanged at 32.50 rupees on 150 shares.
Ireland Blyth climbed 20 cents to 14.80 rupees on 114,609 shares, Rogers was a rupee higher at 102.00 rupees on 1,466 shares and Shell fell 20 cents to 19.90 rupees on 8,350 shares.
National carrier Air Mauritius lost a rupee to 38.70 rupees on 6,408 shares.
